## Summary

One sentence for the release notes: what changes, for whom.

## Problem

Why this change exists, in at most three sentences.

## Change

One bullet per behavior. Group the bullets under an area name (Backend, Dashboard, Collectors) only when the PR spans more than one.

## Rollout

What happens to existing data and DSPs, what a migration does, and anything an operator must do; or "Nothing to do".

## Verification

One sentence of what proved it, then the commands in a fenced block.

## Review

- Code review: what it found and what became of it, or "nothing outstanding".
- Security review, for accounts, permissions, migrations or collectors.
- Set aside: findings left alone, and why.
- CodeRabbit: its findings and their outcome, or "not requested".

## Docs

The docs updated, or "none".

## Screenshots

Only for a change the dashboard shows: the section `npm run pr:screenshots -- publish` prints, before and after per screen, after only for a new screen.
